newsitem.title: CHINA: China May industrial output up 11.9 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: China May industrial output up 11.9 pct yr/yr.

text.p: China's industrial output grew by 11.9 percent year-on-year in May to 178.0 billion yuan ($21.4 billion), the State Statistical Bureau said on Tuesday.
Industrial output was up 11.9 percent in April year-on-year and 11.4 percent for the first four months.

Industrial output of state firms and firms in which the state holds a controlling interest rose by 6.2 percent to 99.7 billion yuan and of that, state firms saw growth of 4.4 percent to 84.5 billion yuan, the bureau said.
Collective industries reported industrial output growth of 13.3 percent to 55.7 billion yuan.
The private sector showed growth of 16.2 percent to 37.8 billion yuan, the figures showed.
Light industry jumped by 13.2 percent year-on-year to 73.5 billion yuan while heavy industry grew by 10.9 percent to 104.5 billion yuan.
The sales rate of industrial products was 94.99 percent in May, up by 0.31 percentage points compared with the year-ago period, the bureau said.
Production of raw steel was up 10.7 percent, steel was up 6.6 percent and steel products grew by 11.3 percent.
Output of primary energy products was up 1.2 percent year-on-year to 112 million tonnes, it said.
The bureau said 370,000 industrial state firms registered profits of 29.32 billion yuan in the first four months, up 39.2 percent year-on-year. In April alone, profits were 13.05 billion yuan.
